title: What to Consider When Choosing an AR Payment Portal Vendor
summary: Dill helps construction wholesalers, distributors, and suppliers automate online payments, accounts receivable, and credit applications. Accelerate your cash flow and customer account onboarding.
body_text: Does it integrate with your existing ERP or accounting software? When considering a payment portal vendor, it is important to evaluate how much time it will actually save and how much it will impact your customer service. A portal that integrates with your ERP can automate cash application and close out open invoices once payment is processed. It can also pull in invoices and statements directly from your ERP, allowing your customers the ability to retrieve copies without having to reach out to your team. If a portal doesn’t sync with your ERP (these are typically just a static payment link), you will still need to go in and manually close out all of your invoices. Your customers won’t be able to see all invoices and statements, making their experience suboptimal and reconciliation for your team more challenging. Ease of use for your company There is little to no point in getting a payment portal if it will be more work for your employees and company. A big reason people consider payment portals is to save their company time, and therefore money. A good portal is simple and intuitive to use for your team and employees. Having the ability to sync with and act as an extension of your ERP is a huge plus. Ease of use for your customers Payment portals are supposed to provide a simple solution for your customers to view invoices and statements and quickly pay you anywhere, anytime. You want to look for a portal with as little friction as possible. If the portal requires more work from your customers to pay you than previously, there will be little incentive for your customers to want to use it. An easy-to-use portal acts as another way for you to provide quality customer service for your customers and differentiate from your competitors, whereas a clunky portal may have the opposite effect. How secure is it? Security and fraud is an unfortunate but necessary consideration when choosing a portal. Most portals involve saving both your business’s and customers’ financial information for quick payments. A portal that encrypts you and your customers’ data is essential for security and peace of mind. You will want to look for portals that prioritize security through encryption and PCI compliance, as well as ones that prioritize fraud prevention through ACH processing and 3DS (two-factor) authentication on card processing. What forms of payment can it process? The form of payments you would like to receive through the portal will play a significant role in your decision process. Some portals can process either credit and debit cards or bank transfers (ACH). The best and most useful portals are able to process both forms and provide you the flexibility. Bank ACH is largely becoming the standard today for B2B payments. Being able to compliantly pass on a credit card surcharge online is important if you’re currently doing this today or are looking to implement a process to reduce processing fees. Cost There are a few different ways vendors charge for their AR payment portal services. Almost all have a combination of a monthly fee, and charge transaction fees for ACH and card processing. These fees typically differ in price or percentage based on a few factors, such as the number of monthly transactions, average transaction size, and annual sales. Keep in mind that if a payment portal vendor offers ACH processing and compliant credit card surcharging, this can factor into your ultimate cost, as it can lead to an overall reduction in processing fees. Customer Service Going with a vendor known for high quality 24/7 customer service and reachable by email or phone provides immense help should your portal ever experience any issues. The ability to quickly troubleshoot any issue and get your portal back online is a big factor. Some vendors will not only provide support to your company but also help your customers get set up through tutorials. Finding a portal vendor that is also continuously doing R&D and incorporates user feedback to improve the platform is a plus. These are the most common questions we have encountered while helping wholesalers and distributors figure out what payment portal is right for them. If you need help with the selection process or have any additional questions, we at Dill are happy to help. For a free consultation, click here .

title: Scaling Smarter: Glimpse’s Roadmap for AI-Driven Financial Workflows
summary: Kushal Negi, CTO, shares how Glimpse’s latest innovations are setting a new standard for automation and visibility in deduction and financial workflow management.
body_text: We launched Glimpse to solve a problem every CPG brand knows too well: Managing deductions is slow, manual, and error-prone, and revenue often slips through the cracks. And our platform has successfully given your teams back hours of work, helped you capture more revenue, and provided a clearer view of your finances. Now, we’re taking it a step further, with even smarter automation, faster workflows, and deeper visibility. Glimpse CTO Kushal Negi shares insights on our latest product launches and how they’re already helping brands deliver 10x impact across finance, trade, and operations. Next-Generation Platform Revamp Over the past year, we’ve learned a lot from you — how your teams manage deductions, what slows you down, and what you need to make faster, more informed financial decisions. Those insights shaped one of our biggest updates yet: the launch of Glimpse’s next-generation platform. This full-stack revamp makes Glimpse more powerful, intuitive, and user-friendly than ever. It simplifies how you manage deductions and financial workflows, improving both efficiency and accuracy. You’ll spend less time navigating disputes, tracking deductions, and digging through files, and more time focusing on initiatives that drive your business forward. With this upgrade, Glimpse can scale right alongside you, supporting expanded retailer coverage, new AI agents, and the growing needs of your team. With the new Glimpse platform, we’ve delivered an upgraded UI and UX that reflects everything we’ve learned about the industry and our customers. Kushal Negi CTO at Glimpse Retailer and AI Agent Expansion Managing deductions shouldn’t mean navigating a maze of retailer portals and inconsistent data formats. That’s why we’ve expanded Glimpse to support even more major retailers, including CVS, Walgreens, Costco, Kroger, Target, and Amazon — with full U.S. coverage underway and international expansion on the horizon. Behind this growth are Glimpse’s AI agents. They connect directly to retailer data sources and standardize unstructured information. From there, they automate dispute workflows — eliminating manual work, improving accuracy, and helping your team scale without adding headcount. We’ve expanded our AI agents to every new retailer integration, automating disputes and making retailer-specific insights instantly accessible. Kushal Negi CTO at Glimpse Scaling Beyond Deductions We’ve upgraded our platform to automate broader financial workflows beyond deductions for your team. This includes critical accounting tasks like cash application and month-end reconciliation. To do this, the platform centralizes and harmonizes raw data from multiple sources — retailer portals, emails, and PDFs — transforming thousands of unstructured files into clean, actionable financial data. That data is automatically integrated into your accounting systems, like QuickBooks or NetSuite, cutting out hours of manual entry for your finance team. With structured, unified data and automated workflows, you gain a complete view of your financial operations on top of the impact of deductions. This enables faster, more informed decisions and helps your team focus on what matters most. We’re automating accounting workflows within brands by turning raw documents into clean, harmonized data. Then, we automatically enter them into accounting systems, saving finance teams hours of work. Kushal Negi CTO at Glimpse New Trade Analytics Feature You asked, and we delivered. One of the most requested features is here: trade analytics with detailed retailer and SKU breakdowns for deductions. These new trade analytics features give your team unprecedented visibility. They extract line-item data from deduction documents, making hundreds of individual items within a single deduction easily visible and actionable. This means you can plan promotions more effectively, track the impact of deductions on revenue, and identify opportunities to recover invalid deductions. Trade analytics also support cross-team collaboration. Sales, finance, and trade teams can now work from a single source of truth — without manually consolidating data — keeping everyone aligned and making faster, smarter decisions. Customers want to see each line item within deductions, so we built trade analytics to provide that visibility and support smarter decisions. Kushal Negi CTO at Glimpse Delivering 10x Impact Across Every Team Glimpse is the first all-in-one solution that combines dispute automation, financial workflow automation, retailer integration, and trade analytics. By providing AI-powered support that integrates seamlessly with your existing processes, we empower your team with the tools they need to work smarter and faster. When every member of your finance, trade, and operations teams has clear visibility and actionable insights, they make better decisions, recover more revenue, and drive growth. Our goal is to empower brands with an all-in-one platform that doesn’t just automate deductions, but transforms how every team manages, analyzes, and acts on their financial data — unlocking value they didn’t even know was there. Kushal Negi CTO at Glimpse Stay tuned for updates as these exciting features continue to evolve. Don’t use Glimpse yet? title: Bringing life-saving medicines to LMICs – Bristol Myers Squibb
summary: Our ASPIRE initiative is more than a promise – it’s doubling access to life-saving therapies in LMICs. Read how patients from Asia to Africa are finding hope.
body_text: Scientific innovation is bringing a healthier world within reach, but patients in medically underserved regions continue to face barriers to the medicines they urgently need. For over 150 years, Bristol Myers Squibb has been at the forefront of global health, and we are dedicated to overcoming these challenges and expanding access to our transformative therapies. Key programs making a difference in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) A critical part of our efforts to reach patients in low- and middle-income countries or LMICs is driven by our ASPIRE strategy – which stands for Accessibility, Sustainability, Patient-centricity, Impact, Responsibility and Equity. Launched in 2024, this 10-year initiative is focused on expanding access to our innovative treatments and delivering potentially life-saving medicines to patients in LMICs. In 2023, we set a 2x2 10-year goal for ASPIRE - doubling both the number of patients accessing BMS’ innovative medicines in LMICs and the number of countries where BMS medicines are available. ASPIRE is off to a strong start and in 2024, we reached 128,000 patients while expanding into markets in Southeast Asia, Latin America and the Middle East. In 2025, we further increased our presence in LMICs by doubling our footprint to 45 countries and achieving a 23% increase in patients served. BMS-IMAP (Innovative Medicine Access Program) is a cornerstone of ASPIRE’s mission, designed to expand access to BMS medicines for patients in lower-income LMICs, where healthcare infrastructure and supply chains are often lacking. Since 2022, IMAP has enabled legal, compliant importation of medicines directly to institutions, and provided medical training on safe and appropriate use of our medicines for healthcare professionals. The program now operates in 26 centers The program now operates in 26 centers in 10 LMICs across Asia, East & West Africa, and has already served over 125 patients. Using expertise across our Medical Affairs team and web-based content, we have completed trainings in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda and trained over 90 healthcare providers. Tangible impact: Changing lives The progress we have achieved through our LMIC strategy at BMS has had a tangible impact on patients. Take Book, a young man living in Thailand — a country with a high prevalence of beta thalassemia. Book gained access to new medicines through the ASPIRE program and can focus on his dreams rather than being defined by his illness. View video transcript I have beta thalassemia, which causes anemia. For example, during times I was very sick, just crossing an overpass or climbing stairs to cross the road. It would make me feel exhausted. People would see me as looking young in their eyes and appearing not very healthy. They assumed I couldn´t work to my full capacity, so I missed out on job opportunities in that area. After getting the doctor´s recommendation about a new medication, I felt hopeful once again. Since I started taking this medicine, I feel brighter and more confident to go out and live life more fully. These days I even go out to play badminton with friends, and I feel I can play longer. I also want to tell all thalassemia patients – you can have both a better life and better health. title: Mozambique LNG: Clarification by TotalEnergies on Financing of the Project
summary: Paris, December 2, 2025 – Further to the communications made by the UK and Dutch authorities regarding the involvement of their Export Credit Agencies, UK Export Finance (UKEF) and Atradius, in the financing of Mozambique LNG project, TotalEnergies wishes to clarify the following: In 2020, Mozambique LNG concluded a project financing for a total amount […]
body_text: Paris, December 2, 2025 – Further to the communications made by the UK and Dutch authorities regarding the involvement of their Export Credit Agencies, UK Export Finance (UKEF) and Atradius, in the financing of Mozambique LNG project, TotalEnergies wishes to clarify the following: In 2020, Mozambique LNG concluded a project financing for a total amount of USD 15.4 billion with a group of approximately 30 lenders including Export Credit Agencies and commercial banks. Due to the prolonged Force Majeure period, Mozambique LNG has negotiated with the lenders an amended financing agreement in order to align the documentation with the updated project schedule. After the lifting of force majeure by Mozambique LNG, and the will of the consortium to resume the project, Mozambique LNG partners decided to proceed without the participation of UKEF and Atradius since these two Export Credit Agencies had not yet reconfirmed their commitment. The Mozambique LNG partners have unanimously agreed to provide additional equity to replace the UKEF and Atradius contributions, representing in aggregate approximately 10% of the external financing. TotalEnergies and its partners would like to thank the lenders representing around 90% of the external financing who have confirmed their commitment to the financing of the project, acknowledging its positive contribution to the development of Mozambique. Furthermore, TotalEnergies has taken note of the reports commissioned by the Ministry of Finance of the Netherlands from external advisors Clingendael and Pangea Risk regarding the human rights and security situation in Cabo Delgado, which were published on 1st December despite the fact that Atradius is no longer part of the financing. TotalEnergies regrets that both external advisors did not travel to Mozambique and conduct on-the-ground investigations by themselves, but produced a report relying mainly on information collected through third parties. Regarding the allegations of human rights abuses by members of the Mozambique Defense Forces, TotalEnergies reiterates the clarifications made by the Company on 20th November 2025 and invites its stakeholders to visit the dedicated webpage on its website here . ***

title: Ryan Specialty Completes Acquisition of Canadian MGU Stewart Specialty Risk Underwriting
body_text: Ryan Specialty Completes Acquisition of Canadian MGU Stewart Specialty Risk Underwriting December 01, 2025 8:30am EST Download as PDF CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Ryan Specialty (NYSE: RYAN) (“Ryan Specialty”), a leading international specialty insurance firm, is pleased to announce that it has completed the acquisition of Stewart Specialty Risk Underwriting Ltd. (“SSRU”) effective as of 12/1/25. SSRU is a managing general underwriter (“MGU”) based in Toronto, Canada specializing in underwriting large-account, high-hazard property and casualty solutions. SSRU is a part of the Ryan Specialty Underwriting Managers (“RSUM”) division of Ryan Specialty. The acquisition was previously announced on October 25, 2025 and that announcement can be found here . About Ryan Specialty Founded in 2010, Ryan Specialty is a service provider of specialty products and solutions for insurance brokers, agents and carriers. The firm provides distribution, underwriting, product development, administration and risk management services by acting as a wholesale broker and a managing underwriter with delegated authority from insurance carriers. Ryan Specialty’s mission is to provide industry-leading innovative specialty insurance solutions for insurance brokers, agents and carriers. To learn more, please visit ryanspecialty.com . About Ryan Specialty Underwriting Managers Ryan Specialty Underwriting Managers is an industry leader in delegated authority underwriting services. Our family of managing general underwriters (MGUs) and national programs have the expertise and authority to design, underwrite, bind, and administer a diverse portfolio of risks. Our value proposition originates with our 950+ industry professionals who are empowered by centralized technical support and policy lifecycle administration, coupled with a broad distribution network of retail and wholesale brokers. We have been diligently servicing our valued clients and trading partners in North America, the UK, Europe and Asia Pacific since our establishment in 2010. To learn more, please visit ryanspecialtyum.com . title: 15 Best Free Grammarly Alternatives You Should Try in 2026

It helps people fix errors, rewrite sentences, and sound more natural when writing emails, essays, or reports. But while Grammarly is widely used, it’s not the only option available. Many other AI grammar checkers and writing tools offer similar or even more specialized features (often for free). In this article, we'll cover the 15 best free Grammarly alternatives that you can use to improve your writing with AI in 2026. Let's dive in! What is Grammarly? It highlights issues in real-time and provides explanations for each correction. This helps you learn from your mistakes and write more accurately over time. AI writing The AI writing feature helps you generate or refine sentences when you need better wording. It suggests improvements for clarity, structure, and flow. You can use it to strengthen arguments, make sentences more natural, or expand short drafts. AI checker (detection) Grammarly’s AI checker reviews your writing for readability and tone. It identifies awkward phrasing, inconsistent style, or unclear sections. This helps you polish your writing to make it sound more professional and consistent. Paraphrasing The paraphrasing feature lets you rewrite sentences to match a different tone or style. You can make your writing more formal, simpler, or more conversational depending on the goal. body_text: Intchains Group Limited (NASDAQ: ICG, hereinafter referred to as “ICG” or the “Group”), a Nasdaq-listed company, announced today that the blockchain staking business of Goldshell, its core brand, has completed full-process compliance preparation and technical deployment, and officially launched commercial operations for global users as of today. Investors can inquire about relevant service information through Goldshell’s dedicated Stake business platform. This milestone marks the Group’s strategic breakthrough in the blockchain infrastructure service sector, injecting new impetus into overall business growth and further improving the Group’s “Mining Machine – Asset – Service” Web3 ecological closed loop. Strategic Acquisition: A Solid Foundation for Accelerating Goldshell’s Staking Business ICG’s recent completion of a pivotal strategic acquisition has laid the groundwork for the rapid launch and scalable operation of Goldshell’s Staking business. The move saw ICG successfully acquire the Proof-of-Stake (PoS) technology platform operated by DxPool for USD 1.3 million—an investment that has directly fueled Goldshell’s expansion into the Staking sector. As a mature infrastructure validated through long-term market testing, the acquired PoS platform brings substantial value: it features a fully developed technical architecture, standardized operational protocols, and a steady global customer base. These strengths equip Goldshell with “plug-and-play” core capabilities, eliminating traditional entry barriers and enabling immediate market penetration. Post-acquisition, the platform has undergone in-depth integration with Goldshell’s existing business ecosystem. Now operating as an independent core business segment, it serves the global market under a refreshed brand identity—turning the strategic acquisition into a tangible driver of Goldshell’s Staking business growth. Having undergone long-term market validation, this platform features a complete technical architecture, standardized operation system and stable customer base, providing three core values for Goldshell’s efficient entry into the staking track: Technical Readiness : Eliminating the need for ground-up construction, directly acquiring a battle-tested technical system covering node operation, revenue calculation and security monitoring; Customer Accumulation : Inheriting the institutional and individual customer resources of the original platform, reducing market expansion costs; Compliance Assurance : The platform has completed basic compliance filings in multiple jurisdictions, providing support for the global launch of services. After the completion of the acquisition, this PoS platform has been integrated into an independent business segment under Goldshell and incorporated into the Group’s overall business matrix for management under a unified brand image. Initially Covering Four Major Public Chains, Technical System Ensures Asset Security and Stable Returns To meet the asset allocation needs of different types of investors, Goldshell’s Stake business covers staking services for four major mainstream blockchain networks at its launch, including Ethereum (ETH), Avalanche (AVAX), Manta (MANTA) and Conflux (CFX). Leveraging the core technical assets accumulated by the acquired platform, Goldshell has built an end-to-end service capability, specifically including: End-to-End Service System : Covering front-end user interaction, back-end technical support and API interface services, adapting to the differentiated operational needs of individual and institutional customers; Standardized Operation Framework : Establishing full-process operation mechanisms such as real-time monitoring of node health, automatic revenue calculation and distribution, and risk early warning; High-Level Security Assurance : Adopting distributed cloud architecture and encrypted database storage to ensure the security of users’ staked assets and the stability of returns. The launch of this business enables the Group to provide cost-effective and highly reliable professional staking services to global users, further expanding the Group’s customer service scope. Improving Ecological Closed Loop to Enhance Comprehensive Competitiveness, Group’s ETH Holdings Staking Plan Implemented As a key extension of the Group’s blockchain ecosystem layout, Goldshell’s Stake business forms a high synergy effect with existing businesses, filling the gap in the Group’s blockchain infrastructure service sector. Currently, ICG has built a complete business matrix covering: 1) R&D and supply of altcoin mining machines; 2) Strategic holding of digital assets such as Ethereum; 3) Web3 innovative application development; 4) Blockchain staking services, forming an ecological closed loop of “Mining Machine – Asset – Service”. Notably, the Group has formulated a staking strategy for its Ethereum holdings and plans to conduct staking business in batches through the Goldshell Stake platform and partner channels. As of the date of this announcement, the Group has completed the staking of 1,000 Ethereum tokens, accounting for 11.3% of the Group’s total Ethereum holdings. This initiative is not only an important measure for the Group to implement its digital asset appreciation strategy, but also accumulates valuable practical experience for the operation of the Stake platform, which will effectively enhance the professionalism and reliability of the platform’s services. Uphold a Long-Term Strategy to Create Sustainable Value for Shareholders Mr. Ding Qiang, Chairman and CEO of ICG, stated: “The official commercial launch of Goldshell’s Stake business is fully aligned with the Group’s core strategic direction of expanding next-generation blockchain infrastructure. This business layout has three strategic significances: First, it enhances the Group’s technical service capabilities, enabling us to participate more deeply in the construction and development of decentralized networks; second, it improves the operational efficiency of the Group’s digital assets through business synergy to achieve asset appreciation; third, it will create long-term and stable investment returns for shareholders through precise capital allocation and rigorous risk management, promoting the Group’s sustainable growth.” A Goldshell representative added: “The Stake business is an important milestone for Goldshell in deeply cultivating the blockchain industry, and also a key carrier for transforming the Group’s technical strength into service capabilities. Relying on mature technical platforms and operational experience, we have gained the ability to provide high-quality services to global users. In the future, we will adopt an open attitude to cooperate with industry partners to jointly promote the large-scale application of blockchain infrastructure.” Future Plan: Expanding Service Scope and Deepening International Market Layout Looking ahead, Goldshell will take the Stake business as its core focus and continue to advance two strategic directions: First, deepen technological R&D and gradually expand support for staking services on more mainstream and potential blockchain networks; second, innovate scenario integration, explore the integration of staking services with scenarios such as Decentralized Finance (DeFi) and digital asset management, and enrich service connotations. Leveraging ICG’s global resource layout and brand influence, Goldshell plans to gradually expand its Stake business to key markets such as North America, Europe and Southeast Asia, striving to build itself into a world-leading blockchain staking service brand and contribute sustained revenue growth momentum to the Group. About Goldshell Goldshell is a core brand of Intchains Group Limited (NASDAQ: ICG), focusing on blockchain technology R&D and digital asset services. Its business covers mining machine supply, blockchain staking services and other fields, and is committed to providing secure and efficient blockchain infrastructure solutions for global users. For more information about Goldshell’s Stake business, investors and users are welcome to visit the official platform: https://stake.goldshell.com/ . About Intchains Group Limited (ICG) Intchains Group Limited (NASDAQ: ICG) is an innovative technology enterprise deeply engaged in the Web3 field. Its core businesses include the R&D and supply of altcoin mining machines, the strategic acquisition and holding of Ethereum and other Ethereum-based cryptocurrencies, as well as the R&D and implementation of innovative Web3 applications. The Group always takes technological innovation as its core driving force, builds a diversified and synergistic blockchain business ecosystem, and is committed to creating long-term value for shareholders. For more company information, please visit the Group’s official website: https://intchains.com/ . Investor Inquiries: For further understanding of the strategic impact of the relevant business on the Group, please contact us through investor relations channels.
